升级或完成任务可获得属性点。分配力量、体质、敏捷和智力，培养你的角色。
在角色信息的属性页面查看并提升属性。
力量：提升攻击力和 TP 上限。
体质：提升防御力、生命上限和生命恢复。
敏捷：提升命中、闪避和暴击。
智力：提升技能攻击力，缩短技能冷却，提高 SP 上限。
其他属性：攻击、技能攻击、防御、命中、闪避、暴击。

Each class has 6 Active Skills that can be acquired at certain levels. Each Active Skill can be enhanced by Active Skill Points, which are granted at LV3 and LV10. You can register the skills in the quickslot.
There are 5 Buff Skills that can also be acquired at certain levels. They can be enhanced up to 10 times by Buff Skill Points, which are granted at LV4 and LV10.
Once you have passed a certain plot point, you can use the Berserk System. You can verify the status of the system in the Buff Skill Window, and can register it in the quickslot to activate it.

When the Berserk System is activated, the TP gauge will be keep decreasing, and the system will automatically shut down when the gauge is empty. You can disable the system at any time by pressing the button assigned to the system. TP can be replenished by slaying monsters or using a TP potion.

You can use Refine to increase the stat of items of equipment. To use the Refine command, you need either a Weapon Refine Stone or Armor Refine Stone. Weapons can be refined 19 times, and armor items are maxed out at 9. Remember: Refine may fail!
You can place an orb or crystal on the item of equipment to give it a special attribute, provided it has empty slots. You can carry this command out at the blacksmith in each town.

"You can ask a blacksmith to regrade all the items of equipment you own. Once they have been regraded, all the options of that item will be adjusted according to its rarity. You need a Philosopher's Stone which you can buy in the Brand Shop."
You can make Orb or Crystal by compounding.
Elemental Orbs can be placed on a weapon. Weapons equipped with orbs have additional attributes.
Stat Crystals can be place on weapons or armor. All the stats the crystal has will apply to your overall stat.
If you are progressing in the Main Quest, you can find a flag in the world and on the area map. However, the flag may sometimes be hidden depending on the quest objective.
8 major towns in the game have coliseums. You can carry out monster raids, and each coliseum has 8~15 different levels. You will receive a reward for clearing the coliseums.
There are Warp Gates in each of the 8 major towns and coliseums. You can use these gates to teleport instantly.

The shop contains some of the very useful items in the game, but you must purchase the Points used in the shop. All the Points and other consumable items are validated until the end of use, and cannot be refunded. Important: please remember that if the game is deleted, the Points and items will also be lost.
